benefits.name: Anniversary Free Night
benefits.description: One free night annually at an IHG hotel with a redemption value up to 40,000 points; points can be added to redeem above that level.
benefits.terms: Covers a standard room and tax only, up to 40,000 points in redemption value. Points can be added on top to book a higher-value room.

benefits.name: Annual Spend Statement Credit & Bonus Points
benefits.description: $100 statement credit and 10,000 bonus points each calendar year in which cardmember spends $20,000 or more.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in calendar-year purchases. Also awards 10,000 IHG bonus points.

benefits.name: Diamond Elite Status (Spend Threshold)
benefits.description: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite status through December 31 of the following year, earned by spending $40,000 or more in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $40,000 in calendar-year purchases. Status is valid through Dec. 31 of the following year.

benefits.name: Platinum Elite Status
benefits.description: Complimentary IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status for as long as the account is open.

benefits.name: 4th Night Free
benefits.description: The 4th night is free when redeeming points for 4 or more consecutive nights at IHG hotels.
benefits.terms: Applies to award (points) bookings of 4+ consecutive nights; every 4th night in the stay is free.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee, once every four years.

benefits.name: United TravelBank Cash
benefits.description: Up to $50 in United TravelBank Cash annually, deposited as two $25 credits per year.
benefits.terms: Deposited as United TravelBank Cash, not a statement credit; usable toward United flight purchases.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass Membership
benefits.description: One year of complimentary DashPass membership plus up to $10 quarterly DoorDash credit.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. Includes up to $10 quarterly credit on non-restaurant DoorDash orders.

benefits.name: Instacart+ Membership & Credit
benefits.description: Three months of complimentary Instacart+ membership plus $10 monthly Instacart credit, up to $120 annually.
benefits.terms: Requires activation. $10 monthly credit available up to $120/year.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.description: Up to $100 per day for 3 days for essential purchases when checked luggage is delayed.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.description: Up to $3,000 per covered traveler for lost, damaged, or stolen checked or carry-on luggage.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation & Interruption Insurance
benefits.description: Reimbursement up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable travel expenses.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days, up to $500 per item.
